passages.context: Exact official Latin control for the conference's preparation and approval of complete faithful translations for submission to the Apostolic See for confirmation, and for adaptation of signs and gestures with Holy See consent and recognition. This adjusts a preliminary norm; it is not a new typical edition and does not govern the minister authorization reserved by CIC c. 1172.
